briefdescription.para: The symbol records of one index pass, keyed by the raw path, the line, and the column.

detaileddescription.para: Each record holds the symbol text and the role bits of one declaration or reference. The raw path is relative to the folder of the unit row.

briefdescription.para: The elements of one document, keyed by the line and then the column of the last token of their name.

detaileddescription.para: A position holds the first element that is stored at it.

detaileddescription.para: The index reads its files child, and it asks the model for the swap file of each path.

briefdescription.para: The path texts.

The loaded library of each family, keyed by family.

briefdescription.para: The declarations of each symbol, as pairs of a path index and an element.

detaileddescription.para: The elements belong to documents. setDocuments rebuilds this map, and addDocument and removeDocuments clear it.

memberdef.type: jam::HashMap< juce::String, jam::Array< std::pair< int, const jam::Document::Element * > > >
memberdef.name: references

briefdescription.para: The references to each symbol, as pairs of a path index and an element.

detaileddescription.para: The elements belong to documents. An element whose role lacks the declaration bit is a reference. setDocuments rebuilds this map, and addDocument and removeDocuments clear it.

briefdescription.para: Creates an empty index that reads the files child and the swap files of a model.

parameterdescription.para: The model that the index reads. The index does not own it.

briefdescription.para: Calls function for each stored document, in ascending order of the path bytes.

detaileddescription.para: The documents are held in a HashMap, which has no order, so the path indices are sorted first. The view that function receives points into paths, and it is valid during the call.

parameterdescription.para: A callable type that takes (std::string_view, const jam::LanguageDocument&).
The callable. It receives the path and the document of each stored entry.

briefdescription.para: Calls function for each element of each stored document, at every depth.

parameterdescription.para: A callable type that takes (int, const jam::LanguageDocument&, const jam::Document::Element&).
The callable. It receives the path index, the document, and each element.

briefdescription.para: Erases each stored document whose path has no row in the files child.

detaileddescription.para: The call also clears declarations and references, because they point into the documents.

parameterdescription.para: The files child whose rows keep their documents.

memberdef.name: setDocuments

briefdescription.para: Adds the symbols of the pending bindings, rebuilds the symbol maps, and writes the documents count.

detaileddescription.para: The processor calls this only when no parse job, index job, build, or precompile runs. The swap files of the documents that gained symbols are written first. When the count equals the stored value, the function sends the change message by hand, so that the listeners of Id::documents still react. Otherwise it sets the property.

memberdef.name: addSymbols

briefdescription.para: Binds the pending records to the elements of the documents, and returns the paths that gained a binding.

detaileddescription.para: The rows of the files child are visited in order, and the records of each row are bound to the elements at their positions. An element takes the first record that binds it in the pass, which the pass tracks in boundElements. The function clears the pending bindings when it ends.

simplesect.para: The path indices whose documents gained a bound element, each listed once.

briefdescription.para: Holds the parsed documents of the source files, the symbols that index them, and the library of each family.

detaileddescription.para: The paths give each source file an index, and that index keys its document. A document stays until removeDocuments or a null addDocument erases it.
